AMBIGUOUS_MODULE_NAME: Package gampleman/elm-visualization exposes the module `Force`, but its dependency ianmackenzie/elm-units (as ianmackenzie/elm-units) already exposes that name. Elm allows two packages to share a module name when no single module imports both; Gren forbids the collision at the package graph (even when no module imports both). This is a language-level difference, not a porting bug. Automatic rename is refused: it would change a public API, is not a pure function of the module name alone (both packages use the same name, so D72 does not apply), and a graph-dependent rename would make the same package emit different Gren under different roots. The `add` command's Elm. module prefix does not help (both sides become Elm.Force and still collide). What you can do: fork one of the two Elm packages and rename the colliding module there (and its importers) so the exposed names no longer clash, then port the fork; or drop a dependency only when the edge is false (see D76). There is no namespacing flag that resolves a same-name collision between two vendored packages.
